_about: Hand-confirmed SNES map -> PR map pairs (US v1.0 map ids; PR (x, y) = SNES (x + dx, y + dy)). tools/snes_maps.py lists them first and its build follows exits from them, so one confirmed room can place its neighbours. Add a pair when you have confirmed it in the game or by its objects; rebuild with: python tools/snes_maps.py build
